name: comp-32
blurb: Email input with label that floats to top on focus.
description: An email field where the label starts centered and smoothly animates upward when focused or when text is entered. Uses CSS :has() selector and focus-within to trigger animation.
use_when: Modern, polished forms where the floating label UX is expected and preferred.
avoid_when: You need to support older browsers without :has() selector support.
a11y: Label linked to input. Animation is smooth. Focus visible and keyboard accessible. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
